messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: exhaustive combinatorial enumeration of order types with linear programming bounds

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration has an order type where no 3 points are collinear and the minimum-area triangle is determined by a triple forming a (3,6,4) balanced partition (3 points on one side, 6 on the other, 4 on the line's extension), with the three points lying near positions (0.288, 0.000), (0.712, 1.000), and (0.500, 0.577), yielding a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/72. Exhaustive enumeration of the 2,334,512,287 order types of 13 points, filtered by LP-derived upper bounds from all 4-point convex hull constraints, proves no order type can exceed this bound."}
